name: Payment Service Provider
description: A payment service provider (PSP) — also called a payment gateway, card processor, Stripe/Adyen/Braintree, or merchant acquirer — an external service that processes card or transaction data on the system's behalf. A PCI-scoped, high-value financial integration outside the trust boundary. The place to look for the PSP, payment gateway, card processor, or the external service handling payments and transactions.
